full_judgment: 9. On perusal of the order of assessment dated (undated) passed by the DCT and the First Appellate Authority it appears that after service of notice under sections 79 and 83(1) of the Income Tax Ordinance, 1984 the representative of the assessee-company appeared before the DCT and submitted documents regarding expenses and sales and thereafter the DCT assessed the return under section 83(2) of the Income Tax Ordinance, 1984 and made disallowances of the expenses on different heads and rejected the sales shown in the return by the assessee-applicant. The First Appellate Authority by order dated 19-5-2015 made some modification holding that the DCT made the assessment on presumption and enhanced the tax liability.
